people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: This is an easy thing in Yahweh’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
translations.bsb: This is a simple matter in the sight of the LORD, and He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
translations.kjv: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the LORD: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.
translations.asv: And this is but a light thing in the sight of Jehovah: he will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
